en: Git good, kid. I did. Eventually.
nn: Bli flinkare, valp. Det vart eg. Til slutt.

en: Back in my day we died less. Allegedly.
nn: På mi tid døydde vi mindre. Visstnok.

en: Was that a strategy or a nap?
nn: Var det ein strategi eller ein lur?

en: Lesson one: the red bar going down is bad.
nn: Lekse ein: når den raude linja går ned, er det dårleg.

en: You call that dodging?
nn: Kallar du det å dukke unna?

en: Hmph. Even my grandmother pulls fewer mobs.
nn: Hm. Sjølv bestemor mi pullar færre monster.

en: Ever heard of a health potion? They're lovely.
nn: Har du høyrt om helsedrikkar? Dei er nydelege.

en: Stand out of the fire. Basic stuff, kid.
nn: Gå ut av elden. Grunnleggjande saker, valp.

en: I've seen squirrels with better survival instincts.
nn: Eg har sett ekorn med betre overlevingsinstinkt.

en: Git good. Then git better.
nn: Bli flinkare. Så bli endå flinkare.

en: That mob is telling stories about you now.
nn: Det monsteret fortel historier om deg no.

en: Was the floor comfy, at least?
nn: Var golvet i det minste mjukt?

en: Bold move. Wrong, but bold.
nn: Modig trekk. Feil, men modig.

en: Practice makes perfect. Practise more.
nn: Øving gjer meister. Øv meir.

en: You died? Shocking. Truly.
nn: Døydde du? Sjokkerande. Verkeleg.

en: Even the murlocs are laughing.
nn: Sjølv murlocane ler.

en: Here's a tip: hit them before they hit you.
nn: Her er eit tips: slå dei før dei slår deg.

en: Your armour is not decoration, you know.
nn: Rustninga di er ikkje pynt, veit du.

en: Pro tip: running away is allowed.
nn: Proffetips: det er lov å springe sin veg.

en: Did you try not dying? Works wonders.

en: I died less with a broken keyboard.

en: That's one way to get to the graveyard fast.

en: Keyboard turning again, were we?

en: Somewhere a trainer is shaking his head.
nn: Ein stad ristar ein trenar på hovudet.

en: The spirit healer knows your name by now.
nn: Åndelækjaren kan namnet ditt no.

en: Git good, whelp. With love. Grumpy love.
nn: Bli flinkare, kvelp. Med kjærleik. Gretten kjærleik.

en: Did you forget you had spells?
nn: Gløymde du at du hadde trolldom?

en: You know the bandages aren't just for show?
nn: Du veit at bandasjane ikkje berre er til pynt?

en: Seriously, eat something between fights.
nn: Seriøst, et noko mellom kampane.

en: A wise hero checks the patrol. You're not wise. Yet.

en: Look before you pull. Revolutionary idea.
nn: Sjå før du pullar. Revolusjonerande idé.

en: Next time try the pointy end of the sword.

en: Ah, the classic over-pull. A rite of passage.

en: Git good. Or at least git slightly better.
nn: Bli flinkare. Eller i det minste litt betre.

en: Were you fighting or sightseeing?
nn: Kjempa du, eller var du turist?

en: You took on how many? At once? Bah.

en: Count the mobs first. Use your fingers if needed.

en: Mobs don't wait for you to finish your tea.

en: I'd say git good, but you know already.

en: That death was textbook. The wrong textbook.

en: Let me guess: it was lag. It's never lag.

en: Did you blink? You can't blink out there.

en: Bravery: yes. Brains: pending.

en: Ha. Welcome to the dirt nap club.

en: I'll lend you my old helmet. It has dents for a reason.

en: I never died to that. Okay, twice.

en: Fighting uphill in heavy boots, were we?

en: Real veterans die with style. You fell over.

en: Repair bill's your tuition fee.

en: Hope you learned something. You didn't, did you?

en: Git good. Git gud. Git anything.
nn: Bli flink. Bli god. Bli noko.

en: In my day we died in the snow, uphill.
nn: På mi tid døydde vi i snøen, i motbakke.

en: Sit in the healer's corner next time.

en: Don't fight the elites alone, kid. Basics.

en: Did the mob read your talent build first?
nn: Las monsteret talentoppsettet ditt fyrst?

en: Interesting tactic. Never use it again.

en: Your corpse is very well positioned. For a corpse.
nn: Liket ditt er godt plassert. Til lik å vere.

en: Back to the graveyard, rookie. Again.
nn: Tilbake til gravplassen, nybyrjar. Igjen.

en: How many lives do you think you have?
nn: Kor mange liv trur du at du har?

en: Infinite lives is no excuse to waste them.
nn: Uendeleg mange liv er inga orsaking for å kaste dei bort.

en: My cane would have survived that.

en: Fell over? Happens. Fell over twice? Hmm.

en: Aggro is not a thing you collect, kid.

en: Heal yourself. You have hands, don't you?

en: They make potions for exactly this.

en: That's not a tank. That's a snack.

en: Watching you fight is like watching soup boil. Then spill.

en: I'd give advice, but you'd die before reading it.

en: Maybe stand behind the big guy next time.

en: Here's a radical plan: don't.

en: Well, that was educational. For the mob.

en: Dying is free. Repairs aren't. Git good.
nn: Å døy er gratis. Reparasjonar er ikkje det. Bli flinkare.

en: Who taught you to fight? Not me, I hope.

en: Did you wave at it? You don't wave at it.

en: A for effort. F for, well. F.

en: Next time, maybe don't jump.

en: Gravity: undefeated. You: not so much.

en: Git good. Or git a healer. Either works.

en: You fight like I dance. Badly and briefly.

en: That was a very brave mistake.
nn: Det var ein svært modig feil.

en: I've seen better tactics from a sheep.

en: A sheep would have fled sooner. Smart sheep.

en: Maybe read your spellbook sometime.
nn: Kanskje du skulle lese trolldomsboka di ein gong.

en: Rested XP doesn't cover deaths, kid.

en: You'll know that patrol's path by heart soon.

en: Kids these days. No respect for aggro radius.

en: The bandages are in your bag. Use them.
nn: Bandasjane ligg i veska di. Bruk dei.

en: Hope you enjoyed the view from the floor.

en: Bah. Git good, as the youngsters say.

en: You're keeping the spirit healer in business.

en: I trained you better than that. I didn't, but still.

en: You're aware you can heal, right?

en: Git good, slowcoach.

en: Ah, overconfidence. My old friend.

en: I'd say watch and learn, but I'm resting.

en: Maybe let the tank go first? Just a thought.

en: Your grave is starting to feel like home, eh?

en: Fighting in the dark? Light a torch next time.

en: I've seen training dummies with better reflexes.

en: Sigh. The youth.

en: At least you're consistent.

nn: Hugs: du er helten, ikkje matbiten.

en: You're braver than me. And deader.

en: Two buttons, kid: fight or flee. Pick one.

en: Next time just shout for me. I'll grumble over.

en: That fall damage was well earned.

en: Next time, take the long way down.

en: Your bravery is noted. Your aim is not.

en: Hm. Interesting choice to stand in that.

en: Did you mistake that dragon for a pony?
nn: Trudde du den draken var ein ponni?

nn: Drakar og ponniar. Lett å blande, er eg viss på.

en: Git good, champion. Or git a bigger shield.
nn: Bli flinkare, meister. Eller skaff deg eit større skjold.

en: Shields go on your arm, not your back.

en: You've turned dying into an art form. Abstract art.

en: Never underestimate a boar. Lesson learned?
nn: Aldri undervurder eit villsvin. Lekse lært?

en: I've seen a level one do better. On a bad day.

en: Back to the drawing board. And the graveyard.
nn: Tilbake til teiknebrettet. Og gravplassen.

en: Let's practise standing up. On three.

en: That was the shortest fight I've seen all week.
nn: Det var den kortaste kampen eg har sett heile veka.

en: Did your keyboard fall asleep?
nn: Sovna tastaturet ditt?

en: You can't charm a mob with good looks.

en: Good looks won't save you. Neither will mine.

en: Git good. My knees creak just watching you.
nn: Bli flinkare. Knea mine knirkar berre av å sjå på deg.

en: Rule one: don't die. Rule two: see rule one.

en: You're the reason they put up warning signs.

en: I knew that pull would end badly.

en: I saw it coming and said nothing. Enjoyed it.

en: Hope your ghost runs faster than you fight.
nn: Håpar spøkjelset ditt spring fortare enn du slåst.

en: You know that's not a friendly mob, right?
nn: Du veit at det ikkje er eit venleg monster, ikkje sant?

en: Red name means angry, kid.
nn: Raudt namn betyr sint, valp.

en: You've been watching too many heroes.
nn: Du har sett for mange heltar.

en: Real heroes check their health bar.
nn: Ekte heltar sjekkar helselinja.

en: Ah, I see you've chosen the floor. Bold.
nn: Å, eg ser du har valt golvet. Modig.

en: Death becomes you. Not really. Get up.
nn: Døden kler deg. Ikkje eigentleg. Reis deg.

en: Even the spirit healer is sighing now.
nn: Sjølv åndelækjaren sukkar no.

en: You must really love that graveyard.
nn: Du må verkeleg vere glad i den gravplassen.

en: Hmph. Clean up your rotation.

en: Maybe stop button-mashing and start thinking.

en: That's what we called a learning moment.

en: I had many learning moments. You'll have more.

en: Shall I draw you a diagram? Mob: bad.

en: I hope that mob gets indigestion.

en: You fell for the oldest trick: being there.

en: Git good, sleepyhead.

en: The mob's still out there laughing. Avenge yourself.

en: Tactical floor inspection, was it?

en: I died in a cooler place than that.

en: Stand behind the mob, not in front. Unless you're the tank.

en: A warrior without a plan is a corpse with a sword.

en: Next time, warn me. I'll bring popcorn.

en: You've got heart. Shame about the health bar.
nn: Du har hjarte. Synd med helselinja.

en: Your gear is weeping. Listen to it.
nn: Utstyret ditt græt. Lytt til det.

en: Run first, think later. That's the rule.
nn: Spring fyrst, tenk seinare. Det er regelen.

en: Funny, you died the same way I did once.

en: I learned from mine. Will you learn from yours?

en: Oh kid, kid, kid.

en: Sigh. Up you get, champion of the floor.
nn: Sukk. Opp med deg, golvmeister.

en: Next time try hitting it. With a weapon.
nn: Neste gong får du prøve å slå det. Med eit våpen.

en: I'll put a pillow on that spot for you.
nn: Eg legg ei pute på den staden for deg.

en: Well, that went exactly as I predicted.
nn: Nja, det gjekk akkurat som eg spådde.

en: I predicted that loudly. Nobody listens to me.
nn: Eg spådde det høgt. Ingen høyrer på meg.

en: Don't feel bad. Feel embarrassed. Briefly.
nn: Ikkje ver lei deg. Ver flau. Kort.

en: Practice dying less. It's a whole skill.
nn: Øv på å døy mindre. Det er ei heil ferdigheit.

en: Courage without caution is a short story.
nn: Mot utan varsemd er ei kort forteljing.

en: I'd ask what happened, but I saw.
nn: Eg skulle ha spurt kva som skjedde, men eg såg det.

en: Don't worry, I only saw everything.
nn: Ikkje uroa deg, eg såg berre alt.

en: Git good. Meanwhile, git up.
nn: Bli flinkare. I mellomtida, reis deg.

en: You almost had it. Almost. Not really.
nn: Du hadde det nesten. Nesten. Ikkje eigentleg.

en: Next time, eat before the fight, not after.
nn: Neste gong et du før kampen, ikkje etter.

en: Those mobs have kids to feed, you know.
nn: Dei monstra har ungar å fø, veit du.

en: You were dinner. Well done.
nn: Du var middag. Godt gjort.

en: Hope that corpse run teaches you patience.
nn: Håpar likløpet lærer deg tolmod.

en: I'll stop teasing when you stop dying.
nn: Eg sluttar å erte når du sluttar å døy.

en: Stop dying? You? I'll wait. Patiently.
nn: Slutte å døy? Du? Eg ventar. Tolmodig.

en: Hmph. You'll be fine. You'll still die. But fine.
nn: Hm. Det går bra med deg. Du døyr framleis. Men bra.

en: Hmph. That's what happens when you skip training.
nn: Hm. Det er det som skjer når du hoppar over treninga.

en: I've told you a hundred times: watch your back.
nn: Eg har sagt det hundre gonger: pass på ryggen.

en: Next time, maybe bring a friend. Or three.
nn: Neste gong bør du kanskje ta med ein ven. Eller tre.

en: You fight like the mobs owe you money.
nn: Du slåst som om monstra skuldar deg pengar.

en: Stop chasing single mobs into whole packs.
nn: Slutt å jage einslege monster inn i heile flokkar.

en: Overpulled again? Shocking. Not shocking.
nn: Overpulla igjen? Sjokkerande. Ikkje sjokkerande.

en: My dog has better aggro control.
nn: Hunden min har betre aggrokontroll.

en: You charged in like a youngster. You are one.
nn: Du storma inn som ein ungdom. Du er ein.

en: That's what armour durability is for. Apparently.
nn: Det er det haldbarheit på rustning er til for. Visstnok.

en: Don't sulk. Practise.
nn: Ikkje surmul. Øv.

en: Ah, the floor. Your second home.
nn: Å, golvet. Den andre heimen din.

en: There's a fine line between brave and dead. You found it.
nn: Det er ei hårfin grense mellom modig og daud. Du fann ho.

en: Git good, kid. The old way: by dying a lot.
nn: Bli flinkare, valp. På den gamle måten: ved å døy mykje.

en: The dying part you've mastered. Now the rest.
nn: Å døy har du meistra. No resten.

en: Look at you, collecting deaths like stamps.
nn: Sjå på deg, du samlar dødsfall som frimerke.

en: You fought bravely for almost two seconds.
nn: Du kjempa modig i nesten to sekund.

en: Hmph. A mob that weak? Really?
nn: Hm. Eit så svakt monster? Verkeleg?

en: The quest said kill ten, not die once.
nn: Oppdraget sa drep ti, ikkje døy éin gong.

en: I'm sure the mob is very proud of itself.
nn: Eg er viss på at monsteret er svært stolt av seg sjølv.

en: Watch your feet. Then watch your health.
nn: Sjå på føtene. Så sjå på helsa.

en: Patience, kid. Wait for the patrol to pass.
nn: Tolmod, valp. Vent til patruljen har gått forbi.

en: You mistook bravery for a strategy.
nn: Du tok mot for ein strategi.

en: Bah. I died less with dial-up.
nn: Pøh. Eg døydde mindre med oppringt samband.

en: Remember the healer? Stand near the healer.
nn: Hugsar du healeren? Stå nær healeren.

en: Ah, the classic: one more pull before resting.
nn: Å, den klassiske: eitt pull til før kvilen.

en: Next time rest first. The mobs will wait.
nn: Neste gong får du kvile fyrst. Monstra ventar.

en: Rest before the pull. The mobs won't, so you must.
nn: Kvil før pullet. Monstra gjer det ikkje, så du må.

en: Your durability is weeping.
nn: Haldbarheita di græt.

en: Did you charge in shouting? I bet you shouted.
nn: Storma du inn medan du ropa? Du ropa nok.

en: It's called a cooldown. Use it.
nn: Det heiter nedkjøling. Bruk ho.

en: Maybe use that big shiny defensive button?
nn: Kanskje bruke den store, skinande forsvarsknappen?

en: Git good. Nobody else will tell you this nicely.
nn: Bli flinkare. Ingen andre seier det så pent.

en: Ha. Even I didn't die that fast.
nn: Ha. Sjølv eg døydde ikkje så fort.

en: Next time read the room. The room had a dragon.
nn: Neste gong får du lese rommet. Rommet hadde ein drake.

en: You have a mount. You could have ridden away.
nn: Du har eit ridedyr. Du kunne ha ridd din veg.

en: Death number how many now? Don't tell me.
nn: Kva dødsfall er det no? Ikkje sei det.

en: That's not how you tank. Or dps. Or heal.
nn: Det er ikkje slik ein tankar. Eller gjer skade. Eller healar.

en: Well. Practice makes less dead.
nn: Nja. Øving gjer mindre daud.

en: Your enthusiasm is admirable. Your survival less so.
nn: Iveren din er beundringsverdig. Overlevinga di mindre.

en: Ah, youth. Charge first, cry later.
nn: Å, ungdom. Storm fyrst, gråt seinare.

en: That was quick. Was dinner ready or something?
nn: Det gjekk fort. Var middagen klar, eller?

en: Maybe check what level that mob was.
nn: Kanskje du skulle sjekke kva nivå det monsteret var.

en: Big skull, big trouble. Remember that.
nn: Stor hovudskalle, store problem. Hugs det.

en: You've got a lot to learn. Learn faster.
nn: Du har mykje å lære. Lær fortare.

en: Git good. Then teach me. Kidding. Never.
nn: Bli flinkare. Så lær meg. Tullar. Aldri.

en: You're making the graveyard look busy.
nn: Du får gravplassen til å sjå travel ut.

en: I'd help, but watching is more fun.
nn: Eg skulle ha hjelpt, men det er morosamare å sjå på.

en: Hmph. Up. Again. Better this time.
nn: Hm. Opp. Igjen. Betre denne gongen.

en: Did you think it would go differently?
nn: Trudde du det ville gå annleis?

en: Next time I'm recording it for the young recruits.
nn: Neste gong tek eg det opp for dei unge rekruttane.
